app.name: Task List
app.summary: Your Home Assistant to-do lists on the screen: tick off tasks and page through the whole list.
app.show_completed_hint: Done tasks stay on the tile, at the bottom, until you clear them in Home Assistant.
app.tick_off_hint: Off: the list is only to read, and a tap anywhere opens the whole list.
app.confirm_hint: A popup asks first, so a task is not ticked off (or on) by accident.
